step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard shows a multi-region architecture split between Region 1 and Region 2. Region 1 contains Service Catalog, CloudFormation, an EC2 Placement Group connected to FSx for Lustre, and an S3 bucket. Cross-region replication copies data from the S3 bucket in Region 1 to an S3 bucket in Region 2. CloudFormation is used to spin up a secondary compute cluster in Region 2 when resources are constrained in Region 1.
